title: AI Exporter Hub - Bulk Export AI Chats to Notion, PDF & Markdown
excerpt: Bulk export ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Genspark, Grok, and Perplexity conversations to Notion, Markdown, Obsidian, or PDF. Choose individual chats or supported histories and collections, keeping available images, files, citations, and code together.
content_html:
All-in-One Chrome Extension

Bulk export ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Genspark, Grok, and Perplexity conversations to Notion, Markdown, Obsidian, or PDF. Choose individual chats or supported histories and collections, keeping available images, files, citations, and code together.

One-click Local Files export

Bulk backup

Clean formatting

Multi-platform

Local Files

Last tested: 2026-07-18

One durable export workflow for conversations, collections, media, and generated files across the AI tools you already use.

6

AI Platforms

3

Output formats

4

Workflows: single, bulk, selective, collection

Compatibility matrix

What AI Exporter Hub can export

A practical support table for real content types and destination behavior.

Content type Support Export result Notes
ChatGPT Supported Export regular chats, selected conversations, Projects, group chats, archived chats, generated sandbox files, and Library images or files. Protected generated files are requested through the connected signed-in ChatGPT tab.
Claude Supported Export individual chats, complete history, selected conversations, complete Projects, or selected Project conversations with supported Artifacts and files. Repeated attachment records and generated Notion child-page links are deduplicated.
Gemini Supported Export individual chats, complete history, selected conversations, Gems, or selected Gem conversations with supported media. Also supports Spark conversations. PDF output includes light, dark, and eye-care themes with readable message-card styles.
Genspark Supported Export conversations, selected conversations, and conversations from Hubs with supported images, files, and presentation assets. Presentation exports preserve available slide content and files; native PPTX output is not promised.
Grok Supported Export conversations, selected conversations, and Project conversations to Notion, Markdown, or PDF. Requires an open, signed-in grok.com source tab; asset availability depends on Grok.
Perplexity Supported Export threads, selected conversations, or selected Spaces with citations, generated images, uploaded media, research documents, code, and downloadable assets. Computer Tasks are also supported. History can be filtered by date, and long jobs stop cleanly when Perplexity rate limits requests.
Notion sync Protected workflow Writes structured conversation pages and uploads supported media only after you authorize and select your own Notion destination. Markdown and PDF do not require an intermediate cloud workspace.

Output proof

Real export examples

Use these examples to verify what exported files, folders, or destination pages look like before installing.

See it in Action

Key Features

Unified Bulk Export Workspace

Example workspace from an earlier release showing four platforms. The current release also supports Genspark and Grok.

Selective and Collection Export

Search and choose individual conversations, or preserve platform context with ChatGPT Projects, Claude Projects, Gemini Gems, and Perplexity Spaces.

Media-Rich Notion Results

Create structured Notion pages containing the readable transcript, uploaded images and files, and generated documents kept beside the messages that produced them.

Key Features of AI Exporter Hub

Everything you need to organize your Multi-platform conversations quickly and efficiently.

Single, Bulk, and Selective Export

Save the active conversation, export complete supported histories, or search and choose individual chats before a job starts.

Projects, Gems, Spark, Hubs, and Spaces

Export conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Projects, Gemini Gems and Spark, Genspark Hubs, and Perplexity Spaces and Computer Tasks. ChatGPT group chats and archived conversations have separate modes.

Cross-Platform Media Handling

Preserve supported images, uploaded documents, generated files, code assets, research documents, SVG visualizations, and downloadable attachments.

Notion File Uploads

Upload supported images and files into your selected Notion workspace, with readable text, Markdown, code, HTML, JSON, and SVG fallbacks as useful child pages.

Markdown and Obsidian Sidecars

Download images and attachments beside portable Markdown notes, then rewrite links so local archives remain readable outside the source platform.

Media-Aware PDF Export

Embed supported chat images in readable PDFs and download non-image attachments alongside the document for durable review packets.

Authenticated Source Downloads

Retrieve protected ChatGPT generated files and supported platform assets through the connected signed-in source tab instead of an unrelated extension page.

Perplexity Research Assets

Preserve citations, sources, generated images, uploaded media, research documents, code assets, and downloadable binary files while deduplicating repeated asset records.

ChatGPT Library Download

Bulk download Library images and files with filters, pagination, progress, cancellation, skip-downloaded support, summaries, and an offline HTML index.

Stable Long-Running Jobs

Configure delays, monitor progress, cancel active work, retry failed items, skip previous exports, and stop cleanly when a platform rate limits a job.

Flexible Organization

Use filename patterns and platform-aware folders for Projects, Gems, Hubs, Spaces, archived chats, Markdown assets, PDF attachments, and Library downloads.

Local-First Privacy

Markdown and PDF exports are generated in your browser. Cloud synchronization only occurs after you authorize your own Notion workspace and choose it as the target.

Known limits

Export boundaries and fixes

Clear limits build trust. These are the cases to check before running large exports.

A connected source tab is required

Conversation details and protected assets depend on the original AI platform session being open, signed in, and readable by Chrome.

Keep the source platform tab open, refresh it after installation or an account switch, and retry the failed item from the same session.

Source platforms control asset availability

An exporter cannot download an expired, deleted, or unavailable asset that the signed-in source platform no longer returns.

Open the original conversation, confirm the image or file is still available, then retry before the source link expires.

Large archives take time

Complete histories, image-heavy conversations, generated files, and destination uploads require controlled sequential work and may encounter platform rate limits.

Test a small selection first, keep the workspace open, configure a delay, and retry failed records instead of restarting the whole archive.

Notion requires authorization

Notion export only works after you connect your own workspace and select a database that the integration can access.

Use the Open database action to verify the destination, or choose Markdown or PDF for a local-only workflow.

What's New

2026-09-24

Added support for downloading Grok project conversations; optimized Gemini export stability; and fixed failures when exporting large PDFs.

2026-09-12

Added ChatGPT LaTeX expression rendering for Notion, Markdown/Obsidian, and PDF exports.

2026-09-05

Improved bulk export stability and added automatic retries when rate-limit restrictions are encountered.

Frequently Asked Questions About AI Exporter Hub

Have another question? Contact us on Discord or by email.

What does AI Exporter Hub export?

AI Exporter Hub exports conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Genspark, Grok, and Perplexity to Notion, Markdown, Obsidian-compatible Markdown, and PDF. It also preserves supported images, attachments, generated files, citations, code, and research assets when the source platform makes them available.

Can I choose individual conversations before export?

Yes. Selective Export lets you search loaded conversations, select or clear individual records, select all visible results, and load complete supported histories before starting the job.

Can I export Projects, Gems, Hubs, and Spaces?

Export conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Projects, Gemini Gems and Spark, Genspark Hubs, and Perplexity Spaces and Computer Tasks. ChatGPT group chats and archived conversations have separate modes. Exporting collection conversations is not a full backup of every collection setting or source file.

Are image and file options enabled automatically?

Yes. Download Image & Files for local exports and Upload Images or Upload Files for Notion are enabled by default. You can change these settings before export.

How are protected ChatGPT generated files downloaded?

AI Exporter Hub resolves and downloads protected generated files through the connected ChatGPT tab that loaded the conversation, preserving the signed-in session needed by the source request.

Can Notion receive attachments and generated files?

Yes. AI Exporter Hub uploads supported images and files to your authorized Notion workspace. Readable text, Markdown, JSON, HTML, code, and SVG assets can be preserved as child pages when that creates a more useful result.

Can I use the Markdown files with Obsidian?

Yes. Markdown exports are portable and Obsidian-compatible, with supported images and attachments downloaded into sibling folders and local links rewritten where available.

Is my data sent to an intermediate cloud workspace?

No intermediate cloud workspace is required for Markdown or PDF. Those files are generated in your browser. Notion synchronization only occurs after you authorize your own workspace and choose it as the export target.

All-in-One Chrome Extension

Bulk export ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Genspark, Grok, and Perplexity conversations to Notion, Markdown, Obsidian, or PDF. Choose individual chats or supported histories and collections, keeping available images, files, citations, and code together.

One-click Local Files export

Bulk backup

Clean formatting

Multi-platform

Local Files

Last tested: 2026-07-18

One durable export workflow for conversations, collections, media, and generated files across the AI tools you already use.

6

AI Platforms

3

Output formats

4

Workflows: single, bulk, selective, collection

Compatibility matrix

What AI Exporter Hub can export

A practical support table for real content types and destination behavior.

Content type 支持 Export result Notes
聊天GPT 支持 Export regular chats, selected conversations, Projects, group chats, archived chats, generated sandbox files, and Library images or files. Protected generated files are requested through the connected signed-in ChatGPT tab.
克洛德 支持 Export individual chats, complete history, selected conversations, complete Projects, or selected Project conversations with supported Artifacts and files. Repeated attachment records and generated Notion child-page links are deduplicated.
双子座 支持 Export individual chats, complete history, selected conversations, Gems, or selected Gem conversations with supported media. Also supports Spark conversations. PDF output includes light, dark, and eye-care themes with readable message-card styles.
Genspark 支持 Export conversations, selected conversations, and conversations from Hubs with supported images, files, and presentation assets. Presentation exports preserve available slide content and files; native PPTX output is not promised.
Grok 支持 Export conversations, selected conversations, and Project conversations to Notion, Markdown, or PDF. Requires an open, signed-in grok.com source tab; asset availability depends on Grok.
困惑 支持 Export threads, selected conversations, or selected Spaces with citations, generated images, uploaded media, research documents, code, and downloadable assets. Computer Tasks are also supported. History can be filtered by date, and long jobs stop cleanly when Perplexity rate limits requests.
Notion sync Protected workflow Writes structured conversation pages and uploads supported media only after you authorize and select your own Notion destination. Markdown and PDF do not require an intermediate cloud workspace.

主要特点

Unified Bulk Export Workspace

Example workspace from an earlier release showing four platforms. The current release also supports Genspark and Grok.

Selective and Collection Export

Search and choose individual conversations, or preserve platform context with ChatGPT Projects, Claude Projects, Gemini Gems, and Perplexity Spaces.

Media-Rich Notion Results

Create structured Notion pages containing the readable transcript, uploaded images and files, and generated documents kept beside the messages that produced them.

Key Features of AI Exporter Hub

Everything you need to organize your Multi-platform conversations quickly and efficiently.

Single, Bulk, and Selective Export

Save the active conversation, export complete supported histories, or search and choose individual chats before a job starts.

Projects, Gems, Spark, Hubs, and Spaces

Export conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Projects, Gemini Gems and Spark, Genspark Hubs, and Perplexity Spaces and Computer Tasks. ChatGPT group chats and archived conversations have separate modes.

Cross-Platform Media Handling

Preserve supported images, uploaded documents, generated files, code assets, research documents, SVG visualizations, and downloadable attachments.

Notion File Uploads

Upload supported images and files into your selected Notion workspace, with readable text, Markdown, code, HTML, JSON, and SVG fallbacks as useful child pages.

Markdown and Obsidian Sidecars

Download images and attachments beside portable Markdown notes, then rewrite links so local archives remain readable outside the source platform.

Media-Aware PDF Export

Embed supported chat images in readable PDFs and download non-image attachments alongside the document for durable review packets.

Authenticated Source Downloads

Retrieve protected ChatGPT generated files and supported platform assets through the connected signed-in source tab instead of an unrelated extension page.

Perplexity Research Assets

Preserve citations, sources, generated images, uploaded media, research documents, code assets, and downloadable binary files while deduplicating repeated asset records.

ChatGPT Library Download

Bulk download Library images and files with filters, pagination, progress, cancellation, skip-downloaded support, summaries, and an offline HTML index.

Stable Long-Running Jobs

Configure delays, monitor progress, cancel active work, retry failed items, skip previous exports, and stop cleanly when a platform rate limits a job.

Flexible Organization

Use filename patterns and platform-aware folders for Projects, Gems, Hubs, Spaces, archived chats, Markdown assets, PDF attachments, and Library downloads.

Export boundaries and fixes

Clear limits build trust. These are the cases to check before running large exports.

A connected source tab is required

Conversation details and protected assets depend on the original AI platform session being open, signed in, and readable by Chrome.

Keep the source platform tab open, refresh it after installation or an account switch, and retry the failed item from the same session.

Source platforms control asset availability

An exporter cannot download an expired, deleted, or unavailable asset that the signed-in source platform no longer returns.

Open the original conversation, confirm the image or file is still available, then retry before the source link expires.

Large archives take time

Complete histories, image-heavy conversations, generated files, and destination uploads require controlled sequential work and may encounter platform rate limits.

Test a small selection first, keep the workspace open, configure a delay, and retry failed records instead of restarting the whole archive.

Notion requires authorization

Notion export only works after you connect your own workspace and select a database that the integration can access.

Use the Open database action to verify the destination, or choose Markdown or PDF for a local-only workflow.

Frequently Asked Questions About AI Exporter Hub

Have another question? Contact us on Discord or by email.

What does AI Exporter Hub export?

AI Exporter Hub exports conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Genspark, Grok, and Perplexity to Notion, Markdown, Obsidian-compatible Markdown, and PDF. It also preserves supported images, attachments, generated files, citations, code, and research assets when the source platform makes them available.

Can I choose individual conversations before export?

是的。 Selective Export lets you search loaded conversations, select or clear individual records, select all visible results, and load complete supported histories before starting the job.

Can I export Projects, Gems, Hubs, and Spaces?

Export conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Projects, Gemini Gems and Spark, Genspark Hubs, and Perplexity Spaces and Computer Tasks. ChatGPT group chats and archived conversations have separate modes. Exporting collection conversations is not a full backup of every collection setting or source file.

Are image and file options enabled automatically?

是的。 Download Image & Files for local exports and Upload Images or Upload Files for Notion are enabled by default. You can change these settings before export.

How are protected ChatGPT generated files downloaded?

AI Exporter Hub resolves and downloads protected generated files through the connected ChatGPT tab that loaded the conversation, preserving the signed-in session needed by the source request.

Can Notion receive attachments and generated files?

是的。 AI Exporter Hub uploads supported images and files to your authorized Notion workspace. Readable text, Markdown, JSON, HTML, code, and SVG assets can be preserved as child pages when that creates a more useful result.

Can I use the Markdown files with Obsidian?

是的。 Markdown exports are portable and Obsidian-compatible, with supported images and attachments downloaded into sibling folders and local links rewritten where available.

Is my data sent to an intermediate cloud workspace?

No intermediate cloud workspace is required for Markdown or PDF. Those files are generated in your browser. Notion synchronization only occurs after you authorize your own workspace and choose it as the export target.
